newsitem.title: JAPAN: TIFFE Euroyen end easier after roller coaster ride.
newsitem.headline: TIFFE Euroyen end easier after roller coaster ride.

text.p: The key September three-month Euroyen contract on TIFFE ended easier on Thursday after a roller coaster ride amid hefty turnover, traders said.

In early trade, it tumbled to 99.13 on a comment by former Japanese vice finance minister for international affairs Makoto Utsumi, made on Wednesday, that Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita was seeking to make an upward correction as soon as possible to the discount rate.
